meta.name: Realm Sprite Pack - Expansion 1
meta.notes: Separate from pack 1: every sheet is prefixed ex_ and this file is atlas_expansion.json. x5 sheets are 5x nearest-neighbour with a 1px outline at scaled resolution (+1px padding per side); tiles, floor decals and ground_shadow are not outlined. 'pivot' = top-left of the sprite's 8x8 base cell inside the frame (tall 8x16 decorations have pivot y = 8 cells down, so anchor them by their base).
